import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def ci(d):
  rng=np.random.default_rng(1);cells=[(k,v.r.values) for k,v in d.groupby(['genre','late'])];bs=[]
  for i in range(2000):
    m={k:rng.choice(v,len(v)).mean() for k,v in cells}
    gs=set(k[0] for k in m); bs.append(np.mean([m[(g,True)]-m[(g,False)] for g in gs if (g,True) in m and (g,False) in m]))
  return np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5])
print('high',ci(w[w.date_confidence=='high']));print('noromcoll',ci(w[~w.genre.isin(['romance','collection'])]))
q=p[p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))].merge(w[['work_id','year']],on='work_id')
print(q[q.year>=1876].sample(5,random_state=2)[['passage_id','year','technology_named']])
